text.description_html:
4 1/2" x 4 1/2" x Square Corners Commercial Brushed Chrome Hinge

Heavy duty steel commercial grade door hinge with 2 ball bearings and Non-Removable Pin.

Security Non-Removable Pin for exterior outswing doors, prevents the hinge pins removal by vandals and thieves. For additional protection we offer Exit Door Security Bars which prevent an exit doors removal, even if the hinges are cut by burglars!

Specifications:

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.134" (Commercial Grade)
  • 2 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Non-Removable Pin for Security
  • US26D Brushed Chrome Finish
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Steel Hinge Pin
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Conforms to ANSI A8112 for Ball Bearing

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually
